name: ai-agent-scrapely
description: AI Setter agent for Scrapely — handles webhook replies, generates AI responses, sends follow-ups via Twitter DMs. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Powers the AI replies. Create one at [openrouter.ai/settings/keys](https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys) and add credits at [openrouter.ai/settings/credits](https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits). Starts with sk-or-.

SCRAPELY_API_KEY.description: Scrapely dashboard → Settings → API Keys → Create Key.

CALENDAR_LINK.description: Your booking link (Calendly, Cal.com, etc.). The AI shares it when pushing for a call.

WEBHOOK_SECRETS.description: Leave the placeholder for now. After deploying, add your Worker URL as a webhook in Scrapely (Settings → Global Webhook), copy the X-Webhook-Key it generates, and paste it here in Cloudflare (Worker → Settings → Variables and Secrets).
